Container.Name: SupabaseStudio
Container.Overview: Supabase Studio is the browser dashboard for managing a self-hosted Supabase project, including database tables, SQL, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, logs, project settings, and API credentials.
Container.Requires: This template runs only the Supabase Studio dashboard container from the official Supabase Docker Compose stack. It does not install Kong, Auth, PostgREST, Realtime, Storage, Edge Runtime, Logflare, Vector, Supavisor, or Postgres. Follow the official Docker guide in ReadMe to deploy the full stack, keep matching image tags together, and place this container on the same custom Docker network as services named kong, meta, analytics, and db before relying on the default URLs below. Generate new secrets with the Supabase scripts before first use; never keep the example keys.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Supabase Studio web interface port. Container port: 3000. The official full stack normally exposes Studio through Kong on port 8000.

Config.Name: Snippets
Config.Description: Persistent SQL snippets folder used by Studio.

Config.Name: Edge Functions
Config.Description: Folder where Studio manages Edge Functions source files.

Config.Name: Hostname
Config.Description: Interface Studio listens on inside the container.

Config.Name: Postgres Meta URL
Config.Description: Internal URL for the Supabase postgres-meta service.

Config.Name: Supabase Internal URL
Config.Description: Internal URL for the Supabase API gateway service.

Config.Name: Supabase Public URL
Config.Description: Public URL clients use to reach the Supabase API gateway, for example http://UNRAID-IP:8000 or https://supabase.example.com.

Config.Name: Postgres Host
Config.Description: Hostname for the Supabase Postgres service as seen from Studio.

Config.Name: Postgres Port
Config.Description: Supabase Postgres or Supavisor session port.

Config.Name: Postgres Database
Config.Description: Supabase Postgres database name.

Config.Name: Postgres Password
Config.Description: Database password generated for the Supabase stack.

Config.Name: PG Meta Crypto Key
Config.Description: Studio postgres-meta encryption key. Generate a unique value before production use.

Config.Name: REST Schemas
Config.Description: Comma-separated Postgres schemas exposed through PostgREST.

Config.Name: REST Max Rows
Config.Description: Maximum rows returned by REST API requests.

Config.Name: REST Search Path
Config.Description: Extra schemas added to the PostgREST search path.

Config.Name: Default Organization
Config.Description: Default organization name shown in Studio.

Config.Name: Default Project
Config.Description: Default project name shown in Studio.

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: JWT secret generated for the Supabase stack.

Config.Name: Anon Key
Config.Description: Legacy anon API key generated by the Supabase key script.

Config.Name: Service Role Key
Config.Description: Legacy service role API key. Never expose this key to client-side code.

Config.Name: Publishable Key
Config.Description: Opaque publishable API key for newer self-hosted Supabase setups.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Opaque secret API key for newer self-hosted Supabase setups. Never expose this key to client-side code.

Config.Name: Logflare URL
Config.Description: Internal URL for the Supabase analytics service.

Config.Name: Logflare API Key
Config.Description: Deprecated compatibility variable. Set to the same value as Logflare Public Token when the Studio image expects it.

Config.Name: Logflare Public Token
Config.Description: Logflare public access token generated for the Supabase stack.

Config.Name: Logflare Private Token
Config.Description: Logflare private access token generated for the Supabase stack.

Config.Name: Enable Logs
Config.Description: Enable the Studio logs interface. Use true or false.

Config.Name: Analytics Backend
Config.Description: Analytics backend provider used by Studio. The official Docker stack defaults to postgres.

Config.Name: Snippets Folder
Config.Description: Path inside the container where Studio manages SQL snippets.

Config.Name: Edge Functions Folder
Config.Description: Path inside the container where Studio manages Edge Functions.

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: Optional OpenAI API key used by the Supabase Studio AI assistant.
